_comment: Hand decisions the automatic gates cannot make. drop: ids that are not one book. retitle: ids whose Gutenberg text is a real book under another name, where the catalogue title is the one to put on screen -- verify_ids.py only retitles when the true work is already in the pool, so these are the leftovers. add: an edition no automatic source offered, pinned to win its dedupe group.

drop.2270: Shakespeare's First Folio: a facsimile of the collected plays, not a book
drop.58360: the Gutenberg text is Volume 10 of 10 of Burton's Nights, not the work
drop.13610: Studies in the Psychology of Sex: one volume of a clinical series
drop.51356: The Birth of Tragedy: philosophy; the lead sentence's word 'tragedy' is the subject, not the form
drop.27635: The Canterbury Puzzles: a puzzle book framed as tales
drop.54812: A Key to Uncle Tom's Cabin: the documentary sources behind the novel, not a novel
drop.1121: old-spelling Shakespeare edition: the text opens on Gutenberg's own note about the spelling, so pg1523 takes As You Like It
drop.2262: old-spelling Shakespeare edition: opens on the editorial note; pg1521 takes Henry V
drop.2268: old-spelling Shakespeare edition: opens on the editorial note; pg1534 takes Antony and Cleopatra
drop.2243: First Folio spelling and the excerpt lands mid-line; pg1515 takes The Merchant of Venice
